patch.value: Export signed native history with an explicit replay capability and omission manifest
Add capability-limited selective native bundles with independent receiver authorization, exact signed manifests, compact reports and no-git SDK/CLI support.
Cross-scope references fail before import; Signatures bind the exact manifest; Unknown omissions prevent a completeness claim

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap recheck: current host is 2026.10.23; pinned SDK is 2026.10.15 and remains unchanged. Core workspace snapshots/history replay, extension capabilities and MCP authorization do not define native selective object archives. Sibling pm-context serves projected context with omission receipts; pm-swarm lanes and pm-web access controls do not bind native closure and replay authorization in a signed manifest. Reuse native bundle hashing/closure, object-store lease, ref CAS, signature key parsing, SDK extension registration/rendering/testing and PmClient tracker operations. Existing forge transport and tenant authorization remain primitives; Phase 6 streaming and pm-vcs-uploadretention receipt expiry remain separate backlog. Contract: select exact native tips and explicit permitted paths/ref names; carry their full ancestry without rewriting identities; refuse histories that reference paths outside scope. Inventory excluded physical objects without payload disclosure; partial or erased source state prevents a source completeness claim. Receiver independently supplies scope, trusted keys and expected ref values before import.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented typed SDK export/inspect/import and vcs bundle commands. Bundles bind exact tips, replay scope, archive digest, included/excluded inventories, unknown omissions and signer key in a domain-separated Ed25519 manifest. Receiver policy is independent, native closure is self-contained even when missing objects are already held, unsupported external links and copiedFrom/checkpoint dependencies outside scope are refused, and explicit ref CAS is checked before storage. Native serializer now supports closed archives that omit clone identity and erasure metadata so import cannot grant repository identity or erasure authority. Local targeted adversarial/no-git validation is in progress; full npm/Bun gates are reserved for CI as requested.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Correctness fix for PR 147: the shared row validator now compares sorted JSON arrays of exact key names, and both tip and lease callers pass the declared ref array directly. The two refs refs/heads/a and refs/heads/b no longer alias the single literal ref refs/heads/a,refs/heads/b. Regression names: comma-containing refs cannot alias two-ref scopes in tips; comma-containing refs cannot alias two-ref scopes in leases. They cover export and signed inspection/import mismatches in both directions, assert unchanged receiver inventory/refs on refusal, and retain valid single-comma-ref and two-ref replay including unordered maps. Revert proof: changed only the structural key comparator back to comma joining, ran node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern=comma-containing test/change-bundles.test.ts, and both regressions failed (2 failed). Restored the structural comparator exactly and reran the same command: 2/2 passed with zero fail/skip/cancel/todo. Typecheck, test typecheck, lint, zero-duplication and docstring checks pass. Local health has the existing pm-vcs-5lre extension host/version skew and advisory stale-item/provenance-domain warnings; no merge receipt reconciliation or history rewrite was needed. value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Finding 1 fixed: import now validates the complete requested ref namespace and destination filesystem before object storage, rejecting parent/child branches, collisions with existing refs in either direction, and empty destination directories with ChangeBundleRefusal code bundle_ref_conflict and a remedy. Regression: destination ref namespace collisions refuse the whole import before storing objects. Reverting only the new admission guard made that exact test fail with EISDIR for refs/heads/0, refs/heads/a, refs/heads/a/b; the other signer fix stayed active. The restored test verifies unchanged object inventory and refs for all collision cases.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Finding 2 fixed: manifest signer trust is re-evaluated with the publication clock inside the native ref transaction callback, after its locks and CAS checks, while the outer object write lease is held. The callback reads the current receiver grant and reloads local trusted-key revocations. Regression: manifest signer revoked during object admission cannot publish refs. Reverting only this final signer validation made the exact test fail with Missing expected exception because the revoked signer published. The namespace fix stayed active. After restoration the regression passes scheduled and newly appended revocations, removed grants and local trust-store revocation, with zero published refs. Authorized admitted objects may remain after a publication-time refusal, as documented.
